capabilities: Pin notes as ribbon actions in the left sidebar
Add, update, and delete pinned notes from the settings screen
Set a hover name, file path, and Lucide icon for each pinned note
extras: Docs only cover setup via the settings screen and issue reporting; no screenshots or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian's ribbon has no built-in way to pin specific notes as one-click buttons for opening often-used files.
summary: Pinned-notes ribbon utility that lets you pin frequently used notes as ribbon actions configured via the settings screen.
